title: Happy young man writing with pen and paper
notes: Evening room: a young man with short dark hair (green-and-white striped sweater) writes in a notebook at a desk, a lit table lamp glowing behind him = lamp-lit desk at night, the GOOD/HARD note-taking of P70 seen from another angle. 0-1.2 s writing, 1.3-3.4 s he glances up with a small smile (noticing what went well), 3.5-7.7 s writes again. Face visible (East Asian, looks younger than the protagonist) but the whole segment is under centre subtitles (blurred/darkened), so it only reads as 'someone noting things down by lamplight'. Warm, medium-dim. Out-of-focus printed papers in the foreground are unreadable (and blurred anyway). One take, 7.76 s. Free writing clips without a face are all bright daytime cafe shots (99888, 1741/1742/1744); the dark ones are Restricted (22855, 46768, 45849, 46765). Alt 99888: a man's hands writing in a spiral notebook at a cafe table, daylight, small embossed logo on a side notebook (needs a blur).

title: Man packing his saxophone
notes: Wide static shot of a vintage lounge (maroon leather banquettes, tall barred windows). 6.5-7.5 s a musician (flat cap, glasses, white shirt, suspenders) sits holding his saxophone upright and looks at it; ~8-13 s lays it in its case and shuts it; ~14 s lifts the case; 15-16 s walks toward camera carrying it (he exits frame-left ~18 s). Reads literally as 'pack this one up and move on'. Backlit: the windows are blown out (BRIGHT windows) while the room is warm and dim, so pull the highlights down. His face is small/backlit and partly cut off by the top of the frame. Period costume, so he is clearly not the protagonist: a generic person. A framed poster at right reads 'CERVEZA' and the frame above it has script lettering -> blur_box (static camera, he never crosses that area before 16 s). The left wall frames have tiny illegible print, and the round emblem on the case is unreadable: no blur. One take, 22.4 s. Alt 25591 (Free): a one-shot composite of a man doing different activities around a living room; bright, faces visible.

title: Trash basket of an office with paper balls
notes: Close shot of a black mesh wastebasket full of crumpled white paper balls on a wooden floor, hand-held with a slight drift. Dim, cool grey, moody; no person, no text. Reads as 'tried again and again, too hard every time' -> 'you get worn out', and the crumpled sheets fit the drawing examples. SPEED: the clip is only 6.34 s, so 6.3 s of source at speed 0.86 = 7.3 s on screen (the subject is static, so the slowdown is invisible; 0.95 is enough for the 6.6 s segment length). No Free clip of a man frustrated at a desk or struggling on guitar frets exists: 24041, 23383, 14693, 36100, 49325, 6718, 6495, 5804, 48029, 15794, 5601, 29961 are Restricted; 8744/4701/25585 were used in ep3. Note: another agent also checked 39845 (same shoot: a man throws a paper ball into this bin). If group C uses 39845 near st30, take alt 51605 (Free): a young gamer in a dark room with teal/RGB light is visibly upset after losing, hands on head ~9 s, pulls his headset off ~14 s; face visible.

title: A young man firmly grips the training climbing wall
notes: Indoor bouldering, tilted camera. A grey chalky wall with a dark grey hold, the same look as the owner's P71. At 0.5 s a man's hand reaches up and grips the top of the hold, at 1-2 s the second hand follows, and at 2-5 s he pulls himself up (dark hair, beard, face in profile ~2.5-5 s, dark sleeveless top). Medium-dim grey gym light. All-centre heading (blurred), so it reads as 'reach for the next hold = a goal one step harder'. No text. One take, 8.7 s. Alt 50915 (Free): hands on a yellow hold; face and a lettered banner in the background.

title: Skillful guitarist playing a black guitar
notes: Close-up of a man's hands on a black acoustic guitar (black T-shirt, face out of frame) in a dim, warm room with soft bokeh. Through 0-8.5 s the fretting hand moves between chord shapes while the right hand strums, with a slow camera drift; from ~9 s the camera slides to the strumming hand, so stop by 8.6. Dim and warm, continues P72's practice. A wristwatch on the fretting wrist has a tiny brand mark on the dial that is illegible even at full resolution: no blur. One take, 17.7 s. (42834 'changing chords' was used in ep3.)

title: Close view of a keyboard player's hands playing
notes: Side close-up of a man's hands (dark skin, blue shirt sleeve) playing an electronic keyboard in a dark room, warm lamp light raking across the keys, slight hand-held drift. Hands only. Dim, warm gold/blue. Reads as unhurried practice for 'switch to an easier part / add one small change'. The panel labels at the left edge are tiny and illegible, and no brand name is in frame. One take, 17.8 s. A different instrument and shot from part 1's 43772 (grand piano). Alt 44142 (Free, same shoot): a closer, darker side view of the right hand.

title: Long-Haired Guitarist Tuning Electric Guitar in Store
notes: A long-haired guitarist with glasses (olive shirt) tilts his head toward the headstock and turns a tuning peg, listening closely. Dark music room, guitars on the wall behind, warm/teal light, dim and moody. Literal for 'hearing a sound you couldn't tell apart yesterday' (tuning by ear; 'an ear close to the guitar'). His face is visible but turned down; with long hair he is clearly not the protagonist and reads as an example musician. The headstock's Epiphone script turns toward camera from ~3.3 s. It stays out of focus until ~5 s and is sharp after 5.2 s, so stop at 5.3 and use the blur_box (the union of its positions 3.3-5.3 s). The wall guitars and the amp show no legible logos. One take, 8.5 s. Alt 3288 (Free): a bassist tuning on a smoky stage, B&W, face mostly hidden by hair.

title: Playing chords on the electric guitar in the dark
notes: Black-and-white, very dark close-up of two hands on a hollow-body electric guitar (picking hand left, fretting hand right) playing unhurriedly, static framing. Hands only, no logos. A B&W source (tint warm if it stands out), but the segment is all-centre (blurred/darkened), so it just reads as calm solo practice at night. One take, 16.6 s.

title: Photographing a delicious dessert
notes: Top-down: a woman's hands hold a black smartphone in landscape over a pancake-and-berries breakfast, framing the shot in the camera app with the thumb on the shutter = 'making a picture to post / show others'. Hands only. BRIGHT, saturated teal table: darken/desaturate. The camera UI has a small readable Cyrillic label 'Режимы' beside the shutter -> blur_box = the union of its positions from 5.0 to 11.0 s (the phone shifts; a small keyframed box would be tidier). The rest of the UI is icons plus a tiny '2x' bubble, and the phone shows no brand logo. One take, 19.6 s. No Free clip of someone photographing a drawing or painting exists (searched photographing, smartphone, photo, artwork, painting, instagram, posting, gallery, selfie, likes...). It is food, not art, but the homemade pancakes read as a hobby result being shot for posting.

title: Steaming mug
notes: A plain grey-green ceramic cup with a spoon on a wooden table, faint steam rising, warm low side light, dark blurred background, static. No person, no text. A quiet private moment for 'keep some hobby time you don't have to show anyone'. The segment is all-centre (blurred/darkened). Warm, medium-dim (sunlit rim). One take, 10.75 s. 3461 'Lighting candles in the dark' (Free) was rejected: jump cuts near 4.9 s and 7 s give no 8.3 s span (its symlink in full/ is unused). Alt 101565 (Free): a candlelit autumn still-life table in chiaroscuro, slow pan.

title: Violinist carefully removing his violin from its case
notes: Dark, warm close-up inside a violin case (maroon velvet lining, bow in the lid). At 0.8-3 s a hand lifts a white cloth off, revealing the violin. At 3.8-5.6 s the violin lies still with light gliding over the varnish (gentle camera drift). Only a sliver of hand, no face; dim and moody like the AI photos. Reads as 'the moment you start, and what you expect from it'. No text. One take, 13.7 s (a hand lifts the violin out ~9-12 s if more is needed). Alt 50551 (Free): a man in a dark jacket raises his camera at a waterfall (5.6 s). It leads straight into P73's camera but is daylight.

title: Close view of a musician playing a Spanish guitar
notes: Close-up of fingers plucking a classical guitar (warm orange top and rosette) against black, light-blue denim shirt and beaded bracelet. From ~4 s the camera starts sliding along the neck toward the fretting hand. Hands only, playing alone, no phone. Medium brightness (a lit subject on black): darken a little. No text or logo (the plain headstock only appears ~10 s). One take, 13.2 s. A different clip and instrument view from st35 (black steel-string) and st36 (keyboard). Alt 44142 (Free): hands on a keyboard in the dark.
